answer: Like an umber mycelial web anchoring fertile soil against a rising ocean of noise, decentralized consensus binds agent trust to a living trellis of staked, multi-hop endorsements. Validation weight flows along mutual attestations, forcing any adversary creating fake identities to confront a superlinear attacker cost: forging consensus rings requires non-linear collateral bonding, collapsing hollow swarms into starved root tips.
